versions.content: Description of Data Exchange Point Shall Provide a Human Readable High-Level Overview Type: valid Description: The standardization template shall support description of a human readable abstract overview of the data exchange point. This overview is expected to be free text. Rationale: Provide brief information to the user about the scope of the profile. Enable the user to decide whether a profile is applicable to an intended data exchange point. Use Case: [UC_STDT_00020] Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
